faq.heading: Seedance Watermark Remover FAQs
faq.intro: Current file support, privacy, processing status, and responsible-use answers.

items.question: Can this remove a Seedance watermark from a video?
items.answer: Not directly yet. The current tool accepts JPG, PNG, and WebP images, so you may process an extracted frame. Native video upload and processing are planned but not implemented.

items.question: Does the current processor actually remove the watermark?
items.answer: Not yet. The preview provider returns an unchanged secure copy while a production Seedance-aware processor is evaluated.

items.question: What files can I upload?
items.answer: One JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP image up to 10 MB. MP4, MOV, PDF, batch, and URL uploads are not supported.

items.question: Is Google sign-in required?
items.answer: You can choose and preview a file anonymously. Google sign-in is required before uploading and creating a processing job.

items.question: How long are files retained?
items.answer: Uploads, results, and job records are designed to expire after 24 hours; signed access links expire sooner.

items.question: Can I process any Seedance media?
items.answer: Only process media you own or have explicit permission to modify. Do not use the service to hide ownership, evade licensing, or misrepresent authorship.

items.question: Does this remove invisible provenance metadata?
items.answer: No. The site concerns visible watermark cleanup and does not claim to detect or remove invisible provenance signals or metadata.
